title: Phantom Blade Zero Characters - All Playable & NPCs
description: Complete list of all Phantom Blade Zero characters. Detailed info on playable characters Soul, Mu Xiaokui, Zuo Shang, and The Chord, plus key NPCs.

sections.title: Playable Characters
sections.content:

sections.title: Soul (魂) — The Dark Raider
sections.content:
Soul is the main protagonist of Phantom Blade Zero. An elite assassin in the service of The Order, he is framed for the murder of the organization's leader — his own adoptive father, Mu Tianmiao.

Background

  • Aliases: "Dark Raider", "Black Blade Soul"
  • Organization: The Order (former)
  • Adoptive Father: Mu Tianmiao (The Order's leader, murdered)
  • Childhood Friend: Mu Xiaokui
  • Close Friend: Zuo Shang

The 66-Day Curse

After being fatally wounded in the heart, Soul is saved by a mysterious Mystic Healer. However, the cure is temporary — he has only 66 days to live. In that time, he must clear his name and uncover the true conspiracy behind the murder.

Combat Style

As the main character, Soul has access to all weapon categories (Regular Sword, Long Sword, Dual Swords) and can equip any Shachi weapon. Players can fully customize his combat approach.

sections.title: Mu Xiaokui (牧小葵)
sections.content:
Mu Xiaokui is Soul's childhood friend and one of the four playable characters. She is connected to the Mu family — the ruling family of The Order.

Key Facts

  • Daughter of the Mu family
  • Grew up alongside Soul
  • Fully playable with unique combat abilities
  • Has her own thematic melody (A minor variation shared with Soul and Zuo Shang)

More details on her combat style and story role will be revealed at launch.

sections.title: Zuo Shang (左商)
sections.content:
Zuo Shang is Soul's close friend and a fellow warrior. He serves as the third playable character in Phantom Blade Zero.

Key Facts

  • Soul's trusted friend and companion
  • Fully playable with unique combat abilities
  • Has his own thematic melody (A minor variation)
  • His relationship with Soul is central to the story

Full combat details and story arc will be available at launch.

sections.title: The Chord
sections.content:
The Chord is the fourth playable character, specializing in mystical Wuxia skills with unique abilities distinct from the other three fighters.

Key Facts

  • Specializes in mystical/supernatural combat techniques
  • Fully playable character
  • Unique skill set different from sword-based characters

More information will be revealed closer to launch.
